metadata.methods_description: Participants performed visual perception tasks during simultaneous EEG and fMRI acquisition. Structural MRI scans were obtained for anatomical reference and co-registration. EEG was recorded using a standard cap with electrodes positioned according to the 10-20 system. fMRI data were acquired using a 3T scanner with standard echo-planar imaging sequences. Visual stimuli were presented on a screen visible to participants in the scanner. Data were preprocessed according to standard neuroimaging protocols and are provided in BIDS format. For detailed acquisition parameters, preprocessing procedures, and participant demographics, please refer to the dataset documentation or contact the corresponding authors.
